title: IBM security advisory (AV26-943)
description: As of September 18, 2026, IBM is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
IBM MQ for HPE NonStop
	Versions 8.1.0 to 8.1.0.40

Sterling File Gateway
	Prior to or equal to 6.2.0.6_1, 6.2.1.0 to 6.2.1.2 and 6.2.2.0 to 6.2.2.1

spectrum-lsf IBM Platform RTM
	Versions 10.2.0.15 and 10.2.0.16
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
